from z3 import *

# Create 16x16 integer variables
X = [[Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(16)] for i in range(16)]

s = Solver()

# Each cell contains a value in 1..16
for i in range(16):
    for j in range(16):
        s.add(X[i][j] >= 1, X[i][j] <= 16)

# Each row has distinct values
for i in range(16):
    s.add(Distinct(X[i]))

# Each column has distinct values
for j in range(16):
    s.add(Distinct([X[i][j] for i in range(16)]))

# Each 4x4 block has distinct values
for i0 in range(4):
    for j0 in range(4):
        s.add(Distinct([X[i0*4 + i][j0*4 + j] for i in range(4) for j in range(4)]))

# Partial assignment
assignments = {
    5: 6, 13: 14, 14: 15, 18: 7, 22: 3, 26: 15, 27: 16, 33: 10, 34: 11, 42: 3, 
    53: 10, 54: 11, 57: 6, 58: 7, 69: 5, 71: 7, 80: 6, 81: 5, 83: 7, 84: 2, 
    85: 1, 94: 12, 103: 15, 106: 4, 107: 3, 109: 5, 112: 14, 115: 15, 120: 6, 
    135: 6, 136: 11, 140: 15, 141: 16, 148: 3, 150: 1, 170: 1, 175: 6, 185: 8, 
    188: 3, 190: 1, 196: 8, 199: 5, 201: 11, 203: 9, 208: 8, 218: 14, 240: 16, 
    241: 15, 243: 13, 244: 12, 253: 3
}

for idx, val in assignments.items():
    r, c = divmod(idx, 16)
    s.add(X[r][c] == val)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    sol = [m.evaluate(X[i][j]).as_long() for i in range(16) for j in range(16)]
    print("SAT")
    print(sol)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
